name: io.github.clawbio/clawbio
description: Bioinformatics-native AI agent skill library: pharmacogenomics, GWAS, variant interpretation, ancestry, single-cell and RNA-seq. Local-first and reproducible; runs demo data by default and never sends genomic data off the machine.

environmentVariables.name: CLAWBIO_MCP_ALLOW_LOCAL_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow skills to read and write local files. Unset, the server runs demo data only, so adding it to a client config cannot by itself grant an agent access to a patient genome.
